**OPNduck v0.5.1-Beta** 🦆

**New**
• MCP server (Settings → System, off by default): let any MCP-capable AI app (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Claude Desktop, LM Studio...) start jobs, watch logs and manage the queue - localhost only, token-protected
• Animated menu icons
• Something hiding for the curious... 👀

Beta: expect bugs. Windows installers untested on real Windows. Tauri still postponed (WebKitGTK stutters/crashes with NVIDIA + Wayland).
